subject: Discovery recap & proposed next steps — Redwood Inference
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Turner <sam.turner@sabletech.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap & proposed next steps — Redwood Inference

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for taking the time today to walk through SableTech's search/retrieval use case. A quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

Recap:
- Primary goal: reduce query latency for customer support search and improve ranking quality across short queries (average 8–12 tokens).
- Current infra: in-house embeddings + a Redis cache; looking to reduce per-query cost while keeping p99 latency < 120ms.
- Success metric: 20% improvement in relevant-first results + consistent p95/p99 latency under load.

What Redwood can help with (high level):
- Low-latency hosted embeddings + configurable batch/kv cache to keep p99 low.
- Dedicated capacity option for predictable throughput and private VPC for security requirement.
- Cost-saving levers: quantization recommendations and intelligent batching that preserve quality.

Proposed next steps:
1) If this sounds like a fit, we can set a short technical deep-dive (30–45m) with your infra/ML engineer to validate latency numbers and discuss integration points.
2) I can share a mutual action plan (attached) with timing estimates and required inputs for an eval.
3) If timing is tight, let me know your preferred quarter and I’ll propose comms accordingly.

Attachments: redwood-discovery-deck.pdf, mutual-action-plan.xlsx

Would you be open to a 30-min technical call next week? I’m available Tue/Wed morning PST. If easier, you can pick a time here: https://calendly.com/marissa_cole/15min

Thanks — looking forward to your thoughts.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Hi Sam —

I know things get busy — just wanted to check in one last time on whether Redwood might be a fit for SableTech right now. A few quick options to make next steps easy: 

- Option A: 15-min sync this week for a quick fit check (book here: https://calendly.com/marissa_cole/15min)
- Option B: Share your top technical concerns and I’ll loop in an engineer to reply asynchronously
- Option C: Not a priority now — tell me the earliest month/quarter that works and I’ll follow up then

If I don’t hear back, I’ll close the outreach for now and re-open in a quarter — but happy to keep the thread active if you prefer.

One quick note: the mutual action plan I attached in the original email includes a proposed 6–8 week eval timeline and the minimal infra changes we expect on your side.

Would appreciate any brief feedback on fit or timing — even a one-line reply helps.
